license_summary: All files are from pngimg.com under CC BY-NC 4.0: attribution required, no commercial use. Fine for the private demo only; for a public or commercial site every one of these must be replaced or re-licensed.
edge_check: For every keeper edge that has opaque pixels on the image border, the opaque width grows at least 2.9x within 6 px of the edge (scripts/clipprofile.py), i.e. curved tangent contact from a tight bbox crop, never a flat cut. Native-res 300 px crops at all touch points (scripts/edges.py, sheets/edges1.png, edges2.png, edges3.png) show no right-angle cuts. Stray-speck count via connected components (scripts/specks.py).
source_note: All keepers from pngimg.com category galleries (boots, women_shoes, hat, women_bag, sunglasses, cowboy_hat, jewelry, necklace, sandals, dress, fur_coat). Direct URL pattern https://pngimg.com/uploads/<category>/<name>.png is the full-size original, not the small/ thumbnail. Gate script and composites in artifacts/demo-sourcing/round2/fashion-scripts and fashion/review.
